div.head: V As Prol., 2
div.ab: And gif hi mon æfre eft on ðæm eorda gemitte, þæt hi syn swa scildig, swa se ðe æt hebbendra handa gefongen syn.
⁊ gif heo man æfre eft on earde gemete, ðæt hy sýn swa scyldige, swa se ðe æt hæbbendre handa gefongen sy.
Et si unquam amplius inibi compareant, sint ita culpabiles, sicut qui furtum habens in manibus capietur.
⁊ gif heo man æfre eft on earde gemete, ðæt hy sýn swa scyldige, swa se ðe æt hæbbendre handa gefongan sy.
And if anyone ever meets them afterwards in their native district, they shall be liable to the same punishment as one who is taken in the act of thieving.
And if they are ever met with in the district, that they are to be liable [to the same penalty] as he who is caught with stolen goods.
Und wenn man sie je wieder in der Heimathgegend trifft, dass sie als so schuldbelastet gelten, wie wer auf handhafter That gefasst wird.
And if they are ever met with again in the home country, that they be held as guilty as one who is caught in the act.
